comparison.objective: Clamp a phone in a spring-loaded car holder, not screen mixed solids.
comparison.physical_skill: Phone placement with controlled spring-arm release versus bimanual sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Phone seated and clamped on its edges with hands clear; no separation metric.
comparison.reason: Spring-clamp loading is unrelated to aperture-based sorting. Versions differ on partial-credit states, not core ability.
